name: interview-extension
description: Firefox extension that blocks distracting sites until today's interview prep is done.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --self-hosted --source-dir . --ignore-files test native README.md dist web-ext-artifacts node_modules package.json package-lock.json .github scripts
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --ignore-files test native README.md dist web-ext-artifacts node_modules package.json package-lock.json .github scripts --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest
